name: Exp_ColorSchaffMFITrendCycle
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffMFITrendCycle custom indicator, which applies a Schaff trend cycle to MFI (Market Facilitation Index). It opens buy positions when the cycle crosses above the high level and sell positions when it crosses below the low level, with configurable position sizing and stop loss/take profit.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorSchaffMFITrendCycle自定义指标进行交易，该指标将Schaff趋势周期应用于MFI（市场促进指数）。当周期指标上穿高阈值时开多仓，下穿低阈值时开空仓，支持可配置的仓位管理和止损止盈。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Schaff趋势周期振荡器应用于MFI指标，通过快慢MFI周期的交叉与循环平滑来识别趋势动量变化。入场条件为：当Color缓冲区值大于5（处于高位区域）且前一值小于6时开多仓；当值小于2（处于低位区域）且前一值大于1时开空仓。出场条件依赖反向信号触发平仓以及固定的止损止盈设置。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举支持多种模式，包括固定手数、基于余额比例、基于可用保证金比例等。资金管理由TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen函数处理，支持5种资金管理模式。策略使用IsNewBar机制确保仅在新K线形成时执行信号检测，避免逐Tick重复交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on applying a Schaff Trend Cycle oscillator to the MFI indicator, identifying trend momentum shifts through the crossover and cyclic smoothing of fast and slow MFI periods. Entry conditions: a buy is triggered when the Color buffer value exceeds 5 (high zone) and the previous value was below 6; a sell is triggered when the value drops below 2 (low zone) and the previous value was above 1. Exit conditions rely on reverse signal triggers for position closing along with fixed stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing is managed through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting multiple modes including fixed lots, balance-based percentage, and free margin-based percentage. Money management is handled by the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen), which support 5 money management modes ranging from free margin to fixed lot sizing. The strategy uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal detection only occurs on new bar formation, preventing repeated per-tick trading.

parameters.description_en: Risk management ratio or fixed lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式：固定手数/余额比例/可用保证金比例等
parameters.description_en: Position sizing mode: fixed lots/by margin/by balance

parameters.name: VolumeType
parameters.description: 成交量类型：跳价量或真实成交量
parameters.description_en: Volume type: tick volume or real volume

pros: 使用IsNewBar机制避免逐Tick重复信号，减少不必要的交易频率
提供5种资金管理模式选择，灵活性较高，适应不同风险偏好
止损止盈参数可配置，默认止损1000点/止盈2000点，风险收益比为1:2
买卖开仓和平仓可独立开关控制，便于单向交易或只平仓模式
使用BarsCalculated检查指标数据是否就绪，避免数据不足时交易
pros_en: Uses IsNewBar mechanism to prevent per-tick duplicate signals, reducing unnecessary trade frequency
Provides 5 money management mode options with high flexibility for different risk preferences
Configurable stop loss and take profit with default 1:2 risk-reward ratio (1000 SL / 2000 TP)
Buy/sell open and close can be independently toggled, enabling directional or close-only modes
Checks BarsCalculated before processing to ensure indicator data sufficiency
cons: 依赖自定义指标ColorSchaffMFITrendCycle，该指标需单独安装且源码不在当前文件中
信号逻辑基于Color缓冲区的魔数阈值（5/6/1/2），缺乏直观解释且难以优化
无追踪止损机制，固定止损止盈无法适应市场波动性变化
未检查现有持仓数量，可能在同方向重复开仓
无点差过滤，在新闻事件或低流动性时段可能导致滑点过大
cons_en: Depends on external custom indicator ColorSchaffMFITrendCycle which must be installed separately and source is unavailable
Signal logic relies on magic number thresholds (5/6/1/2) in the Color buffer, lacking intuitive explanation and difficult to optimize
No trailing stop mechanism; fixed SL/TP cannot adapt to changing market volatility
No check for existing position count, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
No spread filter, which may cause excessive slippage during news events or low liquidity sessions
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓导致仓位过重
添加追踪止损功能，在趋势延续时锁定更多利润
增加点差过滤和交易时间过滤，避免高滑点和低流动性时段交易
improvements_en: Add position count check to prevent duplicate same-direction entries leading to overexposure
Implement trailing stop functionality to lock in more profit during trend continuation
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid high-slippage and low-liquidity periods

risk_points: 无持仓数量检查，可能同方向重复开仓导致风险敞口过大
依赖外部自定义指标，指标缺失时EA将初始化失败
止损1000点较大，在高波动市场可能仍有较大亏损
risk_points_en: No position count check may lead to excessive directional exposure through duplicate entries
Dependency on external custom indicator means EA fails to initialize if indicator is missing
1000-point stop loss is relatively large and can still result in significant losses in volatile markets
